name: Social Proof Notifications
summary: Passive commercial-activity profile of canonical Toast with strict target-supplied truth, optional media/time, canonical dismissal, semantic hidden state, no default live announcement, and target-owned provider lifecycle.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Flow-sized Social Proof profile composed on the canonical Toast root.

anatomy.name: image
anatomy.description: Optional relevant target-supplied image or image wrapper in the Toast visual column.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Canonical Toast content region with no live role by default.

anatomy.name: text
anatomy.description: Visible, trimmed, self-contained and target-verified commercial activity statement.

anatomy.name: time
anatomy.description: Optional trimmed target-formatted time text whose source, freshness and expiry remain external.

anatomy.name: close
anatomy.description: Optional named dismiss action composed through canonical Toast and Close Button.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Canonical Toast item measure with intrinsic content response.

states.name: hidden
states.description: Canonical Toast hidden state is unavailable to pointer and assistive technology; targets may unmount instead.

states.name: visible
states.description: Controlled visible state composed through canonical Toast.

behavior.name: canonicalToastComposition
behavior.description: G10 consumes canonical Toast surface, content, visibility, motion and dismissal composition instead of duplicating notification infrastructure.

behavior.name: validComposition
behavior.description: A non-empty trimmed message is required. Blank or missing message content omits the complete root; no commercial fallback is generated.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: Visible state projects through canonical Toast is-visible and aria-hidden semantics; target timing and queueing remain external.

behavior.name: passiveAnnouncement
behavior.description: Static and default Social Proof has no status, alert, aria-live or focus movement. Repeated commercial activity never becomes an assertive announcement.

behavior.name: truthfulTargetData
behavior.description: The target verifies event truth, source, freshness, expiry, privacy and publication before rendering; the base does not manufacture or validate commercial claims.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: The optional canonical Close Button requests dismissal. Target Toast services own persistence, queueing, rate, timing, pause, Escape, removal and reappearance.

properties.name: message
properties.description: Trimmed, visible, self-contained social-proof statement from current verified target data; blank content omits the component.

properties.name: time
properties.description: Optional trimmed target-formatted time text; blank content omits the part and the target owns freshness/expiry.

properties.name: image
properties.description: Optional relevant product or contextual image supplied and delivered by the target.

properties.name: imageAlt
properties.description: Alternative text when the optional relevant image adds meaning beyond the complete message; use empty text when redundant.

properties.name: dismissAction
properties.description: Optional canonical Toast/Close Button composition that requests dismissal and is omitted when its label is blank.

properties.name: dismissLabel
properties.description: Non-empty localized accessible name required whenever dismissAction is supplied; blank content omits the action.

properties.name: visible
properties.description: Controls item presentation through canonical Toast; target viewport timing, queueing and persistence remain external.

accessibility: Keep the complete commercial claim in visible text and omit the full root when the required message is blank.
Static and default Social Proof has no live role and never moves keyboard focus; marketing content is never assertive.
Compose visibility through canonical Toast semantic hidden state or unmount so hidden actions are unavailable to pointer and assistive technology.
Treat the optional image as decorative with empty alt when the message already supplies its meaning; use informative alt only when it adds relevant content.
Render the optional canonical Close Button only with a non-empty localized accessible name.
Target Toast services own pause, stop, hide, frequency, queue, duration, focus/window pause, Escape and removal policies for automatically changing feeds.
Do not use color, image or relative time as the only evidence or meaning of the claim.
Honor canonical Toast reduced-motion and forced-color behavior.

web.notes: G10 profiles canonical Toast; target-verified data, viewport, queue, timing, privacy, persistence and provider behavior remain external.

shopify.notes: ADR 0253 omits G10 from Shopify v1 until a verified provider or authoritative source and its event qualification, freshness/expiry, privacy, placement, queue/timing, persistence, withdrawal, and focus policy are selected and certified.
